_comment: Name tag and chat bubble rings. They draw no avatar sprite; the game builds them from UI pieces (UI/NameTag.img/<code>: w, c, e; UI/ChatBalloon.img/<code>: nw, n, ne, w, c, e, sw, s, se, arrow, optional head) plus a text colour (clr). Names and Classic ids are from henesys.gg/cashshop. The codes are NOT in that data: they were matched by eye against meowdb.com's in-game previews (ring-previews/<id>.png) and the KMS names on maplestudio.app, so each ring carries a note. White Label Ring has no pieces (the client draws a plain box). Applied by scripts/download-rings.mjs then scripts/build-catalog.mjs.
